answer: The defence rests on lepidoptery society membership with specimen collection log: specimens logged with one society across seasons. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The karst signal separates the two cases at a glance: Forging 277 of these means building 277 separate collection logs from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The haven ledger records each payment, the wander window resets the board, and 277 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
